# ScienceGate

> > ScienceGate is an AI-powered academic search engine indexing over 1 million sources and 87,000 journals to help researchers discover, match, and publish their work.

ScienceGate provides researchers with intelligent tools for searching academic literature, finding suitable journals for publication, and analyzing scholarly metrics. The platform integrates data from major publishers including Elsevier, Springer, Wiley, and IEEE to offer comprehensive coverage of peer-reviewed research across disciplines.

## Key Topics

- AI-Powered Search Engine
- Journal Finder
- Author Search
- Bibliometric Visualization
- Open Access
- Journal Discovery
- Publication Matching
- Research Tools
- Scholarly Journals
- Advanced Search Filters
- Manuscript Submission
- Journal Metrics
- Peer Review
- Academic Publishing

## Core Search & Discovery

- [ScienceGate: Academic Search Engine](https://www.sciencegate.app): Main platform homepage providing access to 1M+ academic sources and 87K journals with AI-powered search capabilities
- [Journal Finder](https://www.sciencegate.app/journal-finder): Intelligent tool for matching research articles to appropriate journals among 86K+ indexed publications
